title: minSize/maxSize use u64 but RFC UnsignedInt max is 2^53-1
description: RFC 8620 §1.3: UnsignedInt MUST be in range 0 <= value <= 2^53-1 (safe integer for JSON float64). EmailFilterCondition.min_size and max_size are typed as u64, which can represent values up to 2^64-1. A value > 2^53-1 in these fields would be a protocol violation that the type silently accepts. The jmap-types crate should either: (a) define a UnsignedInt newtype that enforces the 2^53-1 bound at deserialization, or (b) use u64 but document that values > 2^53-1 are invalid per RFC. This pattern likely affects other UnsignedInt fields in the codebase too. Priority 1 because it's a spec violation — values between 2^53 and 2^64-1 would round-trip incorrectly through JSON (JSON number loses precision for integers > 2^53).
